CATALOG_MANIFEST_RESOURCE_DUPLICATE: manifest repeats a type and key
CATALOG_MANIFEST_DETAIL_PATH_INVALID: detailUrl does not use the canonical resource path
CATALOG_MANIFEST_DETAIL_URL_INVALID: detailUrl is not a relative path below the manifest's directory (wire v8)
CATALOG_MANIFEST_DETAIL_UNDECLARED: detail file has no manifest entry
CATALOG_RESOURCE_DESCRIPTION_MISMATCH: template description and manifest entry description are both present and differ (wire v8)
CATALOG_RESOURCE_KEY_INVALID: a resource key, or a key a resource names, is outside the resource key rule
CATALOG_DEPENDENCY_REFERENCE_MISSING: declared external dependency cannot be resolved
CATALOG_NAMESPACE_INVALID: a catalog or dependency namespace is missing or not a slug, or a content reference names an invalid namespace or a registry without a namespace
CATALOG_REGISTRY_INVALID: a catalog or dependency registry is missing or not a DNS name written in full, or a content reference names an invalid registry
CATALOG_DEPENDENCY_CATALOG_UNDECLARED: a resource dependency names a catalog that catalogDependencies does not declare
CATALOG_DEPENDENCY_CATALOG_DUPLICATE: catalogDependencies declares the same catalog more than once
CATALOG_DEPENDENCY_CATALOG_SELF: a catalog dependency or resource dependency names the catalog itself
CATALOG_DEPENDENCY_CATALOG_VERSION_INVAL: a catalog dependency's version selector is blank or too long, or its recorded release is not SemVer
CATALOG_DEPENDENCY_CATALOG_FINGERPRINT_I: a catalog dependency's release fingerprint is missing although a release is recorded, set although none is, or not v5:<lowercase SHA-256 hex>
CATALOG_RELEASE_FINGERPRINT_INVALID: release fingerprint is not lowercase SHA-256 (before wire v8) or not v5:<lowercase SHA-256 hex> (wire v8)
CATALOG_RELEASE_FINGERPRINT_MISMATCH: release fingerprint differs from canonical content
CATALOG_ATTRIBUTE_IDENTITY_INVALID: catalog attribute uses a malformed catalog or key
CATALOG_ATTRIBUTE_DUPLICATE: catalog repeats a qualified attribute assignment
CATALOG_KEYWORD_INVALID: catalog keyword is not lowercase ASCII letters and digits in hyphen-separated parts
CATALOG_KEYWORD_TOO_LONG: catalog keyword is longer than 30 characters
CATALOG_PRESENTATION_RESOURCE_NOT_ASSET: presentation reference resolves only to a non-asset resource
CATALOG_PRESENTATION_ASSET_MEDIA_TYPE_IN: presentation asset is not an image
CATALOG_ASSET_PATH_INVALID: asset contentUrl is not a relative path below the manifest's directory (from wire v8; before it, not a ./ path free of .. segments)
CATALOG_FONT_VARIANT_INVALID: font weight is outside the CSS range
CATALOG_FONT_VARIANT_DUPLICATE: font repeats a weight and italic face
CATALOG_ATTRIBUTE_VALUES_CONFLICT: attribute mixes inline values and a code-list binding
CATALOG_TEMPLATE_EXAMPLE_KEY_DUPLICATE: template repeats a data-example key (wire v8)
CATALOG_TEMPLATE_EXAMPLE_KEY_INVALID: data example has no key, or one that is not a 1 to 64 character lowercase kebab-case key (wire v8)
CATALOG_TEMPLATE_DESCRIPTION_INVALID: template description is longer than 2000 characters (wire v8)
CATALOG_TEMPLATE_DATA_SCHEMA_INVALID: template data schema has an invalid shape
CATALOG_TEMPLATE_DATA_EXAMPLE_INVALID: example does not satisfy the template data schema
CATALOG_VARIANT_METADATA_INVALID: variant metadata is empty, names more than 16 namespaces, or names one that is not a reverse-DNS namespace (wire v8)
CATALOG_VARIANT_METADATA_TOO_LARGE: variant metadata exceeds 8 KiB serialized (wire v8)
CATALOG_ASSET_CONTENT_HASH_INVALID: binary contentHash is not a lowercase hex sha-256
CATALOG_ASSET_CONTENT_HASH_MISMATCH: binary contentHash is not what its bytes hash to
